parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan blade assembly of a ceiling fan, typically made of lightweight aluminum for efficient air movement.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to circulate air and create airflow in the room.
parts.Movement_description: The fan blades rotate around the central axis when powered by the motor.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or motor housing of the ceiling fan, made of steel for structural support and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the motor and supports the fan blades, connecting them to the ceiling mount.
parts.Movement_description: The base body remains stationary while the internal motor drives the rotation of the fan blades.
